description: This file defines the TerminationReason entity class used in the OrangeHRM system, representing reasons for employee termination stored in the database. It includes properties for id and name, along with getter and setter methods, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: TerminationReason
classes.description: Entity class representing a termination reason with properties for ID and name, including accessor methods, used in database ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the termination reason.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the termination reason.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the termination reason.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the termination reason.
